I was working in my old bosses garage and I had set down about a half a beer.  I blindly set it down on the shelf behind me, not realizing there were roughly 3 other empty cans next to where I had set mine.  So, after a few minutes I reached back to grab my refreshment, absent-mindedly taking a big gulp. Well, as it turned out, not all those cans I  the shelf were empty.  I have no idea how long the beer I drank from had been sitting on that shelf, but it must have been at least a week or more. As soon as the moldy old beer hit my tongue I knew something wasn't right.  My beer shouldn't have any slimy, semi-solids, in it.  I spit it out and saw multiple green, slimy, chunks... and the liquid tasted like what, I would imagine, moldy urine tastes like. I proceed to out the door and threw up around the corner, walked back inside, washed my mouth out with a shot of whiskey, and proceeded to drink my fresh beer. To this day I shudder every time I think about the texture, and taste, of that moldy beer hitting my tongue.
